job.title: Primary & Secondary Teachers, Christian Schools Victoria
job.description:
Primary Teacher and Secondary Teacher roles | Christian Schools | Melbourne and Regional Victoria | Full Time and Part Time | Visa Sponsorship Available

Inspired Recruitment has partnered with a number of Christian schools across Victoria, and we are currently recruiting passionate Primary Teachers and Secondary Teachers to join their teaching teams. These are values-driven school communities, in metropolitan Melbourne and regional Victoria, where faith, learning and student wellbeing go hand in hand.

Whether you are an experienced classroom teacher, a leader looking for your next step, or a graduate teacher ready to start your career in a supportive Christian school, we would love to hear from you. Visa sponsorship is available for outstanding teachers.

About the opportunities

Our partner schools are Christian independent schools offering Foundation to Year 12 education. We are recruiting for full time, part time and fixed term teaching positions, with many roles starting in Term 1, 2027. Current opportunities include:

  • Primary Teachers (Foundation to Year 6), including generalist classroom teachers and specialist teachers
  • Secondary Teachers (Years 7 to 12) across all learning areas, with strong demand for Maths, Science, English, Humanities, Digital Technologies, HPE, LOTE and the Arts
  • VCE Teachers and teachers experienced with the Victorian Curriculum
  • Learning Support and Inclusion Teachers supporting students with diverse learning needs

Key responsibilities

  • Plan, deliver and assess engaging, differentiated lessons aligned with the Victorian Curriculum and VCE study designs
  • Integrate a Christian worldview into teaching and learning, and support the Christian ethos of the school
  • Monitor, report on and celebrate student progress, communicating openly with parents and carers
  • Create a safe, inclusive and positive classroom environment that supports student wellbeing
  • Collaborate with colleagues, take part in professional learning and contribute to school life, chapel and co-curricular programs

About you

  • A committed Christian with an active personal faith, who can model Christian values to students and the school community
  • A recognised teaching qualification (Bachelor or Master of Teaching, or equivalent)
  • Current Victorian Institute of Teaching (VIT) registration, or eligibility to obtain it
  • Excellent classroom management, communication and relationship-building skills
  • A genuine passion for teaching, student growth and continuous improvement
  • Graduate teachers and overseas-trained teachers are welcome to apply

What's on offer

  • Competitive teacher salary in line with experience
  • Visa sponsorship available for outstanding teachers, including support with VIT registration
  • Supportive, faith-based school communities with strong values and great staff culture
  • Ongoing professional development and career progression pathways
  • Smaller class sizes and well-resourced learning environments in many of our partner schools
  • A dedicated education recruitment consultant supporting you from application through to your first day

Faith questionnaire

As these positions are with Christian schools, all applicants will be asked to complete a short faith questionnaire before being put forward. To speed up your application, please include written answers to the following two questions with your CV:

  1. Please describe your experience in personal salvation.
  2. Please describe how your faith affects your daily life.

Applications that include answers to both questions will be prioritised.

About Inspired Recruitment

Inspired Recruitment is a specialist education recruitment agency working exclusively in Primary, Middle, Secondary and Special Needs teaching placements across Australia. We take the time to understand each teacher and each school, so we can find the right fit for both. We are proud to be a SEEK SARA Awards 2026 finalist for Excellence in Candidate Experience.

How to apply

Click Apply and submit your CV along with your answers to the two faith questions above.

job.title: Food Technology Teacher
job.description:
Food Technology Teacher 

Location: Melbourne’s Inner West, VIC
Employment: Full-time

Are you passionate about food, education and inspiring the next generation? We're looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Food Technology Teacher to join our growing team at our secondary school in Melbourne’s Inner West.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who loves food, enjoys sharing their knowledge and wants to inspire students to develop practical skills, creativity and an understanding of food, nutrition and technology. Candidates MUST have a VIT. 

About the Role

Working closely with our teaching staff and wider school community, you will deliver engaging and practical Food Technology lessons that encourage students to explore food, develop culinary skills and understand the important role food plays in our everyday lives.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Planning and delivering engaging Food Technology lessons across secondary year levels.
  • Teaching practical cooking skills, food preparation techniques and kitchen safety.
  • Developing students' understanding of nutrition, food science and food sustainability.
  • Supporting students with food product development, design challenges and practical projects.
  • Managing and maintaining a safe, clean and well-organised food technology kitchen.
  • Ensuring compliance with food safety, hygiene and relevant workplace safety requirements.
  • Assessing student learning, providing feedback and supporting individual student development.
  • Developing creative learning experiences that connect food technology to real-world applications.
  • Maintaining equipment, ingredients, resources and relevant classroom documentation.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A qualification in Food Technology, Food Science, Home Economics or a related discipline.
  • Candidates MUST have a VIT registration number 
  • A recognised teaching qualification and current or eligible Victorian teacher registration.
  • A genuine passion for food, education and working with young people.
  • A creative and engaging approach to teaching and learning.
  • The ability to inspire students and foster a positive, inclusive learning environment.

Previous experience teaching Food Technology in a secondary school environment will be highly regarded, although we welcome applications from enthusiastic early-career teachers looking to develop their teaching career.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about food, education and helping students discover their potential, we'd love to hear from you!

Teach where you are wanted, in the school that actually fits you

Inspired Recruitment works with more than 600 schools across Australia, including government, Catholic and independent schools right across Melbourne and regional Victoria. We recruit across the full Victorian Curriculum F to 10 and VCE. If you teach it, we most likely have a school asking for it.

English: English, English as an Additional Language (EAL), Literacy, Literature, English Language

Mathematics: Mathematics, Numeracy, General Mathematics, Mathematical Methods, Specialist Mathematics, Foundation Mathematics

Science: Science, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Psychology, Earth and Space Sciences, Biological Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Physical Sciences, Environmental Science

The Humanities: Civics and Citizenship, Economics and Business, Geography, History, Legal Studies, Accounting, Business Management, Politics, Sociology, Classical Studies, Religion and Society, Religious Education, Texts and Traditions

Health and Physical Education: Health and Physical Education, HPE, PE, Sport Science, Outdoor and Environmental Studies, Health and Human Development, Food Studies

The Arts: Dance, Drama, Theatre Studies, Media Arts, Media, Music, Instrumental Music, Visual Arts, Art Making and Exhibiting, Art Creative Practice, Visual Communication Design, Studio Arts, Photography

Technologies: Design and Technologies, Digital Technologies, Applied Computing, Software Development, Data Analytics, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Product Design and Technologies, Materials Technology, Wood, Metal and Textiles, Food Technology, Agricultural and Horticultural Studies

Languages: Arabic, Auslan, Classical Greek, French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latin, Modern Greek, Spanish, Turkish, Vietnamese, Victorian Aboriginal Languages, and other Roman and non-Roman alphabet languages, plus LOTE and CLIL programs

Capabilities and cross-curriculum: Critical and Creative Thinking, Ethical Capability, Intercultural Capability, Personal and Social Capability, Respectful Relationships, Careers and Pathways

Senior secondary pathways: VCE, VCE Vocational Major, Victorian Pathways Certificate, VET in Schools, VCE Extended Investigation, International Baccalaureate PYP, MYP and Diploma

Where the work is

Some of our strongest school partnerships sit in Gippsland, Mildura and Wodonga, including Traralgon, Sale, Bairnsdale, Morwell, Warragul, Leongatha, Wangaratta, Wodonga, Albury, Mildura, Swan Hill and Robinvale. These schools move fast, they look after the teachers who join them, and many offer relocation support, subsidised housing and incentive payments.

We also recruit right across Melbourne, including the CBD and inner city, Inner North, Inner West, Northern Suburbs, Eastern Suburbs, South Eastern Suburbs, Bayside, Mornington Peninsula, Yarra Ranges, Melton, Wyndham, Werribee, Casey and Cardinia, plus Geelong and the Bellarine, Ballarat, Bendigo, Shepparton, Warrnambool, Horsham and Colac.

  • Current VIT registration, or an application in progress, or eligibility to register with the Victorian Institute of Teaching
  • A recognised teaching qualification, Bachelor of Education, Master of Teaching or equivalent
  • The right to work in Australia

What you will get

  • Competitive Victorian teacher salaries, with the new Victorian Government Schools Agreement lifting rates significantly, and independent and Catholic schools setting their own scales that often sit above award
  • Access to permanent, ongoing, contract and fixed term roles, many of which are never advertised publicly
  • Salary packaging, professional development funding, mentoring for graduates and genuine progression to Learning Specialist and leadership
  • A consultant who knows the schools personally and will be honest with you about culture, workload and leadership before you commit

Ready when you are

Apply now with your CV, or register your interest for Term 1 and we will keep you in the loop as roles come through. Even if you are just starting to look, have a confidential chat with us and see what is out there.
